tei:div.tei:p: )dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dang*// mkha' mnyam yongs la bde skyid 'byung ba dang*// bdag gzhan ma lus tshogs bsags sgrib byang nas// myur du sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog ༈ /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// de 'dzin mdzad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams// dpal 'byor gyis brgyan yun ring zhabs brtan shog ༈ /bla ma sku khams bzang bar gsol ba 'debs// mchog tu sku tshe ring la gsol ba 'debs// phrin las dar zhing rgyas la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma dang 'bral ba med par byin gyis rlobs// phan bde'i 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnams// sku tshe rgyal mtshan brtan gyur cig ༈ /chos rnga chen po'i sgra yis ni// sdug bsngal sems can mthar bgyid shog /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas su// chos ston mdzad cing bzhugs gyur cig ༈ /gtsug lag khang rnams klog pa dang*// kha bton gyis rgyas legs gnas shog /rtag tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang*// dge 'dun don yang 'grub par shog ༈ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// bde legs phun sum tshogs pa yis// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog// /
